supporting_observations.claim: The provided records do not identify a PowerShell process or otherwise record the reported brief window. The process records shown for WS-JFROST-01 are for WmiPrvSE.exe at 13:21 and its termination at 13:27, not activity around 13:40.

At 13:42, DC-MAP-01 issued a service ticket for ali.hassan to WS-JFROST-01$ from 10.53.10.23. A later record identifies 10.53.10.23 as the source address of WS-AHASSAN-01; this is consistent with, but does not establish, the organization’s approved remote-administration path.

At 13:42, WS-JFROST-01 connected to DC-MAP-01 over SMB, and the DC recorded a network logon by the workstation’s machine account. These records do not show PowerShell execution or establish that this SMB activity caused the reported window.

At 13:45, WS-JFROST-01 used the proxy for a Windows Update Agent HTTPS tunnel transferring about 38.8 MB from the server. This is consistent with patch-related activity, but does not establish that the reported PowerShell window was for patching.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not include a process-creation event identifying PowerShell on WS-JFROST-01 around 13:40; the available process records for that host are at 13:21–13:27 (T144-00001, T144-00002, T144-00023, T144-00024).
The records do not show the contents of the 13:42 SMB session or the activity on WS-JFROST-01 resulting from the ali.hassan service-ticket request (T144-00098, T144-00101).
The supplied evidence does not establish whether endpoint process telemetry was complete during the review window.
claims_not_established: Whether PowerShell actually ran on WS-JFROST-01 around 13:40, and what command or script it may have executed.
Whether the ali.hassan service-ticket request from 10.53.10.23 led to remote administration or was related to the reported window.
Whether the Windows Update activity or scheduled patching explains the reported PowerShell window.
Whether any observed activity was unauthorized or malicious.
additional_evidence_needed: Endpoint process-creation and PowerShell operational/script-block logs for WS-JFROST-01 covering 13:20–14:20 UTC, including parent process, command line, user, and logon session.
Remote-management, SMB, and authentication logs from WS-JFROST-01 and WS-AHASSAN-01 around 13:40–13:43 UTC to determine whether ali.hassan initiated a session and what ran.
The patching record for this workstation and any execution or file-access logs for \\FILE-MAP-01\IT\Patch-Workstations.ps1 during the window.
Confirmation from ali.hassan or the IT change record of whether they administered or patched WS-JFROST-01 at that time.
